lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance, roughly circular blobs arranged in a semi-ordered grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank, posterior to the gill region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical linear features of slightly elevated pixel intensity that intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a localized grid-like anchor structure.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal linear ridges visible along the upper flank, displaying a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the superior edge and shadowing on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A sparse distribution of small, high-luminance blobs localized within the visible macro-mask of the first dorsal fin's silhouette, primarily along the leading edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a high-contrast, elongated white feature (consistent with an Echeneidae specimen) attached to the ventral-lateral region posterior to the pectoral fin.
